faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Quick answers about tracing, photos, free images, Pro and ads.

items.question: Is DrawingPilot free?
items.answer: Yes, it is free to download and use, with ads and a few limits (10 projects, 60-second recordings, line art and pencil styles). DrawingPilot Pro is a one-time purchase that removes ads and unlocks unlimited projects, HD conversions, blueprint and cartoon styles and recordings of any length. It is not a subscription.

items.question: Do you upload my camera or my drawings?
items.answer: No. The camera is used as a live view for tracing. Photos, projects and line art stay on your device unless you save, share or export them yourself. DrawingPilot has no account and no server of its own.

items.question: Where do the free images come from?
items.answer: From Openverse, a search engine for Creative Commons and public-domain images. The creator and licence are shown before you use an image, and the source page is kept with the project. Follow the licence, for example credit the creator or skip non-commercial images for paid work.

items.question: Can I send a photo from another app?
items.answer: Yes. Use Share → DrawingPilot in Photos, Safari, Files, Pinterest, WhatsApp and other apps. You can also pick an image from Files or Google Drive, or paste one from the clipboard.

items.question: Can I make a time-lapse for Reels or TikTok?
items.answer: Yes. Record a tracing session, then tap Export: choose Reels/TikTok (9:16), square (1:1) or the original frame, and a speed up to 16×. The video is saved to your photo library and opens the share sheet.

items.question: Which languages does DrawingPilot support?
items.answer: English, Hebrew, Arabic, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Portuguese, Russian, Japanese, Korean and Chinese (Simplified).

items.question: Can I turn off personalised ads?
items.answer: Yes. Open Settings → Ad privacy choices to review or change ad consent. On iPhone you can also decline tracking in the App Tracking Transparency prompt. DrawingPilot Pro removes ads.

items.question: Where are my projects stored?
items.answer: On your device. You can put them in folders, rename them, duplicate them, share them or delete them. Uninstalling the app removes that copy.

items.question: Does line art use a server?
items.answer: No. The line art, pencil, blueprint and cartoon conversions run on the phone.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.metaDescription: Privacy Policy for DrawingPilot — AR drawing and tracing. No account, photos stay on your device, free-image search via Openverse, ads by Google AdMob with consent.
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how Zuki Apps handles information when you use DrawingPilot and the pages we publish for it.

section1.title: 1. Who we are
section1.content: The data controller is Zuki Apps. Contact details are at the end of this Policy.
section1.content2: This Policy applies to the DrawingPilot app for iOS and Android and the legal pages we publish for it.

section2.title: 2. Information we collect
section2.content: DrawingPilot has no account and no server of its own. Your drawings stay on your device. Some features use services from other companies, described below.
items: Camera: the live camera is shown so you can trace an image onto paper, and you can record that session. We do not upload the camera preview. A recording, or a time-lapse you export, is saved to your photo library only when you save it.

Photos and projects: images you import from your gallery, camera, Files, the clipboard or another app (Share → DrawingPilot), line art, project names and folders stay on your device. Line art and video exports are created on the device. We do not receive those files.

Free image search (Openverse): when you search for free images, the words you type are sent directly from the app to Openverse (api.openverse.org, run by the WordPress Foundation) to find Creative Commons and public-domain images. Thumbnails and images load from Openverse and from the sites that host them, which see your IP address like any website. We do not receive or store your searches. The source page of an image you use is saved with the project on your device.
Purchases: DrawingPilot Pro is a one-time in-app purchase processed by Apple or Google. We do not receive your payment details. The app checks your purchase with the store on your device.

Advertising: Google AdMob may process your device's advertising identifier, IP address and ad interactions to show and measure ads. On iOS, the advertising identifier is used only if you allow tracking. The app may also show ads for other Zuki Apps. Pro users see no ads.

Crash reports and diagnostics (Firebase Crashlytics): device model, OS version, app version, the screens visited before a crash and the technical details of the crash. They do not include your photos, project names or search words.
Usage analytics (Firebase Analytics), only after you give consent: screens opened and coarse feature events. Events never contain project names, image contents or search words.

section3.title: 3. How we use information
items: Show the tracing camera and save what you choose to keep
Search free images when you ask (Openverse)
Unlock Pro after a purchase through Apple or Google
Show and measure ads (Google AdMob)
Find and fix crashes
Understand which features are used, if you consented
section3.content2: We do not sell your personal information.

section4.title: 4. Advertising and consent
section4.content: Where required, you are asked for consent before personalised ads are shown, using Google's consent form. On iOS, Apple's App Tracking Transparency prompt asks before the advertising identifier is used.
section4.content2: You can review or change ad consent in the app under Settings → Ad privacy choices, and limit ad tracking in your device settings.

section5.title: 5. Storage and security
section5.content: Photos, projects, line art and videos stay on your device unless you save, share or export them yourself. We do not run a server for DrawingPilot and do not store your data. Data sent by the services below is encrypted in transit.
section5.content2: Google retains advertising, crash and analytics data under its own policies. Openverse handles search requests under the WordPress Foundation's privacy policy. Apple and Google handle purchases under their own policies.

section6.title: 6. Third-party services
section6.content: Google AdMob and Firebase (Crashlytics, Analytics) process data under Google's privacy policy. Openverse processes image searches under the WordPress Foundation's privacy policy, and images you open load from their source sites. Apple (App Store) and Google (Google Play) process in-app purchases.
section6.content2: Saving a recording uses your photo library. Sharing a project or video uses your device's share sheet; we do not see what you share or with whom. Images shared into DrawingPilot from other apps are copied to the app on your device only.

section7.title: 7. Your rights and children
section7.content: Depending on your region you may have rights to access or delete data. Delete projects in the app, or uninstall the app to remove everything stored on the device. We hold no account or server-side data about you. For data held by Google, Apple or Openverse, see their privacy controls, or email us and we will help.
section7.content2: DrawingPilot is not directed at children under 13, and it is not part of a Designed for Families program.

section8.title: 8. Changes
section8.content: We may update this Policy from time to time. We will post the revised version with a new Last updated date.

terms.metaDescription: Terms of Use for DrawingPilot — AR drawing and tracing.
terms.intro: Please read these Terms of Use carefully before using DrawingPilot. By accessing or using the app you agree to these Terms.

section1.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
section1.content: These Terms govern your access to and use of DrawingPilot ("Service", "App"), operated by Zuki Apps.
section1.content2: If you use the Service on behalf of a minor, you represent that you are the parent or guardian and accept these Terms on their behalf.

section2.title: 2. Description of Service
section2.content: DrawingPilot helps you trace a reference image onto paper. The Service includes:
items: A reference image over the live camera, with size, rotation, opacity and lock
Import from your gallery, camera, Files, the clipboard or other apps, and on-device line art
Free-image search through Openverse
Projects stored on your device, recordings saved to your photo library, and time-lapse exports for Reels, TikTok and Instagram
Ads served by Google AdMob, and an optional one-time Pro purchase

section3.title: 3. Your content and images by others
section3.content: You keep the rights to the photos and drawings you create. You are responsible for having the right to trace or import an image, including images you share into the app from other apps.
section3.content2: Free images come from Openverse under Creative Commons or public-domain licences chosen by their creators. The creator and licence are shown before you use an image; you must follow that licence (for example, credit the creator, or do not use a non-commercial image for commercial work). We do not own or license those images.

section4.title: 4. Licence and purchases
section4.content: Zuki Apps grants you a personal, non-exclusive, non-transferable licence to use the app on devices you own or control. The app is free to download and shows ads.
section4.content2: DrawingPilot Pro is an optional one-time in-app purchase, billed by Apple or Google, that removes ads and unlocks extra features. It is not a subscription and does not renew. You can restore it on devices signed in to the same store account. Refunds are handled by Apple or Google under their policies. Projects stay on your device; we cannot restore them if you uninstall or change devices.

section5.title: 5. Acceptable use
items: Use the app for unlawful purposes or to copy work you have no right to copy
Reverse engineer or tamper with the app or its ads
Interfere with the app's normal operation or with the services it uses (such as Openverse)

section6.title: 6. Disclaimer
section6.content: The app is provided “as is” and “as available”. Tracing depends on your camera, lighting and how you hold the phone. To the extent permitted by applicable law, Zuki Apps disclaims all warranties, express or implied.
section6.content2: Nothing in these Terms excludes or limits liability that applicable law does not allow to be excluded or limited.

section7.title: 7. Limitation of liability
section7.content: To the maximum extent permitted by applicable law, Zuki Apps is not liable for indirect or consequential damages, or for loss of data, arising from your use of the app.

section8.title: 8. Changes
section8.content: We may modify these Terms. Continued use after the effective date constitutes acceptance.

howToUse.title: How to use
howToUse.subtitle: Pick an image, line it up, trace.

steps.title: Choose a reference
steps.description: Import a photo from your gallery, camera or Files, share one from another app, or find a free image. Turn it into line art if you like.

steps.title: Line it up
steps.description: Drag, pinch and rotate the image over the paper. Set the opacity, then lock it.

steps.title: Trace
steps.description: Follow the lines on the paper. Use the grid or the torch if the light is poor.

steps.title: Keep it
steps.description: The project stays on your device. Record the session and export a time-lapse for Reels or TikTok, or share the image.
